decisions.reason: The pixelation check adds a rendering-quality constraint but does not change image inclusion, selection, placement, timing, or full-page treatment.
Pixelation concerns technical rendering quality, not the images' thematic fit, chapter mapping, tone, or colour-palette consistency.
The source decision concerns chapter-image pixelation and does not affect Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or punctuation.
The image-pixelation constraint does not change copyright-page publisher attribution or presentation.
The source concerns chapter-image rendering and does not affect removal of the literal newline artifact from the title.
In the immediate context, "they" refers to the full-page chapter images; the source does not establish a pixelation constraint for the separate paperback cover.
Checking chapter images for pixelation does not change the requested guidance about publishing steps, materials, or front and back matter.
The image-rendering constraint does not alter manuscript prose, approved rewrites, flow, or repetition-removal requirements.
The pixelation check does not modify which client-authored manuscript revision or approved prose edits must be integrated.
